replay_a.failure: files.pythonhosted.org read timeout while downloading plotly-6.9.0 before snapshot collection

cases.reason: A single complete snapshot is insufficient for V6 Pass, and no state difference can be inferred without the missing replay-A snapshot.

causal_checks.freshness: Each case used two distinct container IDs, detached checkouts, control directories, and writable layers with no shared writable volume.
causal_checks.identity: Every raw replay matched the frozen repository revision, Git tree, bootstrap hash, image identity, platform, and preregistration identity.
causal_checks.network_isolation: All containers were disconnected by the host; every collected snapshot independently reported no default route.
causal_checks.state_equivalence: All four complete replay pairs matched exactly across Python runtime, marker environment, the full installed-distribution multiset, and content-addressed project metadata/provenance.
causal_checks.infrastructure_separation: Gpkit replay A failed before snapshot collection on a package-host read timeout, so it is counted as bootstrap infrastructure blocked and V6 Unknown, not V6 Fail.

conclusions: Round 16 establishes prospective real V6 Pass evidence for four of five Dev-5 repositories under the unchanged preregistered exact-state contract.
No normalized state drift was observed in any complete replay pair; the only unresolved case lacks a pair because one online bootstrap failed before measurement.
The result does not justify a fifth V6 Pass, a held-out generalization claim, an Official Pass, or a leaderboard claim.
No local Round 16 retry is permitted by the frozen contract. Remaining package-fetch reliability must be handled by a separately preregistered server-side artifact/cache protocol.
